stem: The imagery in stanzas 3 and 4 suggests that —

options.label: A
options.text: Dad is not confident about Brandy’s ability to drive

options.label: B
options.text: Brandy is unable to see because of the dust

options.label: C
options.text: Dad is in a hurry to finish the task

options.label: D
options.text: Brandy is keenly aware of her surroundings
